note: Scenario hitches (docs/168 §3): one hitch-measured repro job per player scenario, Bridgeport, measurement settings of freeze-measure.json (asi.0329 all-on set, [Harness] ForegroundRender=1, [HitchAttr], RouteJobPhases + SyncPlans, LogFallbackMs 20 / stack 16, profile.noSamplers, frames.csv kept loaded, per-task attribution on by default). The repro's first step waits out the load minute; its step windows (step + 10 s) are excluded from the real-only tables by design, so read them as the scenario's own cost: node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts --scenario scenario-hitches-<date> (per step label: iterations and freezes >= 100/300/1000 ms, max, beside the same run's natural rate). freeze-report.ts <tag> for FPS. ~12 min per job (travel ~20), ~1 h 20 min. Timing: clean night only.

jobs.note: travel: trip home from France (profile.travel france goes out before the window on a Matrix copy; the trip home is the scenario). 10 min profile with --repro scen-travel (repros.json), measurement settings of freeze-measure.json (asi.0329 all-on set, [Harness] ForegroundRender=1, [HitchAttr], RouteJobPhases + SyncPlans, LogFallbackMs 20 / stack 16, profile.noSamplers, frames.csv kept loaded, per-task attribution on by default). Pass: every repro step ok (profile-world fails fast otherwise), no crash, 0 watchdog lines, freezes.jsonl and frames.csv not empty. Read: hitch-ab.ts --scenario <tag>.
